qualifier: canonical NLRP1/NLRP3/AIM2 inflammasomes with IL-18 signaling
name: Canonical inflammasome pyroptosis and IL-1/IL-18 maturation
rationale: Members cover NLRP1/NLRP3/AIM2 inflammasomes, pyroptosis and IL-1/IL-18 processing and signaling; unlike neighbours focused on IL-1 cytokine production or caspase-4/5 non-canonical inflammasomes, this theme centres on canonical inflammasomes and IL-18.

core: VEGF and Tie2 receptor signaling in endothelium
qualifier: lymphatic endothelial differentiation and specification
name: VEGFR and Tie2 signaling in endothelial and lymphatic specification
rationale: All members concern VEGF/VEGFR2-neuropilin and Tie2 signaling driving endothelial fate, survival and lymphangiogenesis, while neighbours concern sprouting angiogenesis, its negative regulation, or arterial/venous identity.

qualifier: CCR7 ligand-driven chemotaxis and survival of mature dendritic cells
name: CCR7-driven dendritic cell migration and maturation
rationale: Members share CCR7/CCL19/CCL21 signaling that drives mature conventional dendritic cell chemotaxis, survival and lymphoid homing, distinguishing it from general chemokine, CXCR4 or B/T cell homing neighbours.

core: Vitamin and cofactor metabolism and transport
qualifier: thiamine, riboflavin, vitamin E and ubiquinone rather than folate or cobalamin
name: Thiamine, riboflavin, vitamin E and coenzyme Q metabolism
rationale: Members are metabolism and transport of thiamine, riboflavin, vitamin E and ubiquinol/quinone, whereas confusables cover folate, cobalamin and methionine/one-carbon metabolism.

qualifier: glial versus neuronal fate and oligodendrocyte differentiation with myelination
name: Glial versus neuronal fate and oligodendrocyte differentiation
rationale: Members regulate glial fate specification, oligodendrocyte/astrocyte/Schwann cell differentiation and myelination, unlike neighbours about neuroblast proliferation or mature myelin maintenance and gliosis.

qualifier: Nef/Vpu receptor downregulation and host restriction of HIV
name: HIV Nef/Vpu receptor downregulation and host antiviral restriction
rationale: Members cover HIV entry, Env/Vpu synthesis, Nef/Vpu-mediated downregulation of CD4, CD8, CD28 and MHC-I via ubiquitin-proteasome, and host suppression of viral release, distinct from HIV reverse transcription or PD-L1/MHC-I antigen processing neighbours.

core: 3'-UTR control of mRNA stability and translation
qualifier: HuR/AUF1 stability control and L13a translational silencing
name: HuR/AUF1 and L13a 3'-UTR control of mRNA fate
rationale: Members concern 3'-UTR-dependent mRNA stabilization/destabilization (HuR, AUF1), localization and translational silencing (L13a/GAIT), whereas confusables centre on TTP/BRF1/KSRP decay, stress granules or RNA editing.

qualifier: von Willebrand factor-platelet adhesion variants and plasminogen regulation
name: Coagulation, fibrinolysis and von Willebrand factor-platelet adhesion
rationale: Members span the extrinsic/common coagulation cascade, fibrin formation and dissolution, plasminogen activation and VWF/GPIb/ADAMTS13 variants, distinguishing them from contact-pathway FXII and factor VIII/IX defect neighbours.

qualifier: homing to and development of secondary lymphoid tissue
name: Chemokine-directed leukocyte homing and secondary lymphoid tissue development
rationale: Members cover chemokine receptor/S1P signaling and Rac/Cdc42-driven migration of dendritic, T, B, NK and mast cells plus lymph node and MALT development, unlike integrin-adhesion or monocyte chemokine neighbours.

qualifier: beta-catenin destruction complex and Hippo-YAP/TAZ signaling
name: Wnt/beta-catenin destruction complex and Hippo-YAP signaling
rationale: Members cover Wnt ligand secretion, destruction-complex regulation and its cancer mutants, TCF transcription, non-canonical Wnt/Ca2+ and Hippo-YAP/TAZ signaling, separating it from Notch, Hedgehog, planar polarity and RUNX3/TGF-beta neighbours.

qualifier: gp130 cytokines LIF, CNTF, IL-11 and OSM rather than IL-6 itself
name: LIF, CNTF and IL-11 gp130-family cytokine signaling
rationale: Members concern IL-6-type cytokine receptor signaling via STAT for LIF, CNTF, IL-11 and OSM, whereas confusables centre on IL-6 itself or IL-2/IL-7/STAT5 cytokines.

core: Basement membrane laminin and collagen interactions
qualifier: dystroglycan complex linkage and AChR clustering
name: Basement membrane laminin-dystroglycan linkage and AChR clustering
rationale: Members cover laminin, basement-membrane collagens, proteoglycans and integrin interactions linked to the dystrophin-glycoprotein complex and acetylcholine receptor clustering, unlike collagen crosslinking, hemidesmosome or myogenesis neighbours.

core: Stress-activated JNK and p38 MAPK regulation
qualifier: downstream of TAK1 and TNF/ALPK1 signaling
name: TAK1-driven JNK and p38 stress MAPK regulation
rationale: All members regulate JNK and p38 stress kinase cascades, notably via TAK1 downstream of TNF and ALPK1, distinct from neighbours on TLR/NOD upstream activation of TAK1 or AP-1/ERK outputs.

qualifier: deoxypurine turnover, NUDT nucleotide sanitization and thiopurine metabolism
name: Purine (deoxy)nucleotide catabolism, sanitization and thiopurine metabolism
rationale: Members cover catabolism of purine (deoxy)nucleosides and nucleotides (ADA, PNP defects), NUDT hydrolysis protecting DNA and azathioprine/TPMT metabolism, unlike purine synthesis/salvage or pyrimidine catabolism neighbours.

qualifier: intermediate filament-linked desmosomes and hemidesmosomes
name: Intermediate filament-anchoring desmosomes and hemidesmosomes
rationale: Members cover desmosome and hemidesmosome assembly, intermediate filament bundling, cardiomyocyte and epithelial adhesion and laminin/collagen anchoring, contrasting with adherens-junction polarity, integrin or cornification neighbours.

qualifier: receptor cleavage releasing Notch, ERBB4 and p75NTR intracellular domains
name: Regulated intramembrane proteolysis of Notch, ERBB4 and p75NTR
rationale: Members concern proteolytic activation and intracellular-domain signaling of Notch, ERBB4 and p75NTR, whereas confusables centre on Notch target-gene transcription.

qualifier: Sanfilippo, Morquio and Maroteaux-Lamy mucopolysaccharidoses
name: Heparan, keratan and chondroitin sulfate degradation: Sanfilippo-Morquio mucopolysaccharidoses
rationale: Members are lysosomal HS/CS/KS degradation and the Sanfilippo, Morquio and Maroteaux-Lamy syndromes, distinct from Hurler, Hunter, Sly and Natowicz neighbours.

qualifier: cadherin (CDH1, CDH11) and TGFBR3 gene expression
name: Transcriptional control of cadherin and TGFBR3 genes
rationale: Members concern transcriptional activation and repression of CDH1, CDH11 and TGFBR3, unlike RUNX3, mesenchymal BMP/TGF-beta or general DNA-binding neighbours.

qualifier: ribosome quality control and translation-coupled mRNA decay
name: Cytoplasmic translation cycle and ribosome-associated mRNA surveillance
rationale: Members span cap- and IRES-dependent initiation, elongation, termination, ribosome rescue/RQC and NMD/no-go/non-stop decay, distinct from nuclear RNA processing and hypusine/hydroxylation neighbours.

qualifier: MutS/MutL homolog (MSH2, MSH3, MSH6, MLH1) defects
name: DNA mismatch repair and MutS/MutL homolog defects
rationale: All members are mismatch repair, mostly its MSH2/MSH3/MSH6/MLH1 defects, whereas confusables concern double-strand break and recombinational repair.

qualifier: germinal center, Tfh help and isotype switching
name: Germinal center B cell maturation, isotype switching and plasma cells
rationale: Members cover germinal center and Tfh differentiation, IgA/IgG class switching, plasma cell differentiation and B/plasma cell immunoglobulin modules, unlike BCR signaling and B/T development neighbours.

qualifier: second heart field, cardiac neural crest, outflow tract and great arteries
name: Second heart field and outflow tract-great artery morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover second heart field specification, cardiac neural crest migration, outflow tract septation and pharyngeal arch, pulmonary and coronary artery morphogenesis, unlike valve, atrial, chamber-myocardium and conduction neighbours.

qualifier: granulocyte lineage (neutrophil, eosinophil, mast) and G-CSF/GM-CSF signaling
name: Granulocyte lineage differentiation and G-CSF/GM-CSF signaling
rationale: Members concern myeloid progenitor commitment to neutrophil, eosinophil and mast cell fates with G-CSF/GM-CSF signaling, unlike monocyte/macrophage M-CSF or RUNX-target neighbours.

qualifier: primitive and definitive erythropoiesis
name: Primitive and definitive erythrocyte differentiation
rationale: Members concern primitive and definitive erythrocyte differentiation and hematopoiesis with late erythroid modules, unlike HSC homeostasis, myeloid progenitor or erythro-megakaryocytic neighbours.

qualifier: ovulation, corpus luteum formation/regression and progesterone
name: Ovulation, luteal function and progesterone in ovarian cycle
rationale: Members cover ovulation, luteinization, luteolysis, estrous cycling and progesterone synthesis/response, distinct from follicle growth, gonadotropin and germ cell neighbours.
